item.title: 🔵 Improving Smart Tiered Cache for Public Cloud Regions
item.description:
Why this matters: Leadership context — useful for risk, budget, and vendor conversations.
Smart Tiered Cache allows for precise upper tier selection for origins hosted on AWS, GCP, Azure, and Oracle Cloud with customer-provided cloud region hints.

Source: Cloudflare Blog  |  Severity: FYI  |  Age: 1d ago

item.title: 🔵 Why we cannot wait for better post-quantum signature algorithms
item.description:
Why this matters: Regulatory/compliance signal — assess applicability and remediation timeline.
NIST is advancing nine new post-quantum signature algorithms as potential candidates for future standardization. We take a closer look at all of them, and argue that while they are in the works and show great potential, we should use ML-DSA for now — the best one currently available.

Source: Cloudflare Blog  |  Severity: FYI  |  Age: 2d ago
